description.en: The ID of the bandwidth package.
The ID of the nat gateway. If specified, the operation returns only bandwidth packages associated with the specified nat gateway.
The page number. Starting value: 1. Default value: 1.
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20.
The ID of the region where the bandwidth package is located.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-bandwidth-packages --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --bandwidth-package-id example-string --nat-gateway-id example-string --page-number 1 --page-size 1 --region cn-hangzhou
